---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_hisat2"
description: "Align reads to a reference genome using hisat2 then sort with samtools"
keywords:
- "align"
- "sort"
- "rnaseq"
- "genome"
- "fastq"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "hisat2/align"
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
- "bam_sort_stats_samtools"
input:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "HISAT2 genome index file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.ht2"
- splicesites:
    type: "file"
    description: "Splice sites in gtf file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(splicesites)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fai}"
- save_unaligned:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Save unaligned reads to FastQ files"
output:
- orig_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Unsorted BAM file containing read alignments straight from HISAT2.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- summary:
    type: "file"
    description: "Alignment log.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional output FASTQ files containing unaligned reads.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted BAM/CRAM/SAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM/SAM index file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bai,crai,csi}"
- stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools stats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.stats"
- flagstat:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.flagstat"
- idxstats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.idxstats"
authors:
- "@priyanka-surana"
maintainers:
- "@priyanka-surana"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/hisat2/align@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bam_sort_stats_samtools@0.0.0-df69bf6"
